articles.summary: The loss of more than 3 GW of data center demand in Virginia shows why policy must address operational behavior, not just costs, writes AIxEnergy.io founder Brandon Owens.

articles.title: US-Canada trade war threatens electricity imports, prices
articles.summary: If Canada opts to reduce or eliminate electricity exports to New England, the impact would be largely financial — at least under typical weather conditions, according to the region's grid operator. A previous 25% tariff in 2025 lasted only a day.

articles.title: Bills rise when utilities use conflicting forecasts to drive gas and electric investment
articles.summary: Integrated planning can lower costs to ratepayers by reducing duplicative spending, and New York could lead the way, write experts at Current Energy Group and Advanced Energy United.

articles.title: Commonwealth Fusion Systems aims to complete demonstration reactor with $1B funding round
articles.summary: CEO Bob Mumgaard said the reactor, SPARC, is now “about 80% complete.” Experts remain divided over how soon they believe fusion technology could be commercialized.

articles.title: Microsoft, PowerHouse Hillwood dispute data center service agreements
articles.summary: Data center agreements in Wisconsin fail to protect ratepayers, Microsoft says. Separately, PowerHouse Hillwood has accused Exelon’s ComEd of using monopoly power to quash an agreement for an Illinois data center.

articles.title: PJM eyes option to jumpstart surplus interconnection pathway
articles.summary: PJM’s surplus interconnection process has produced limited results while MISO and SPP are studying about 15 GW and 14 GW, respectively — mostly battery storage. PJM's current rules hinder hybrid projects, observers say.

articles.title: ERCOT aims to complete Texas governor’s data center audit by December
articles.summary: The pause on new data center interconnections could impact the Electric Reliability Council of Texas’ upcoming long-term load forecast and reliability assessment, officials said Thursday.

articles.title: Romanian plant taken offline as Hungary moves to keep Paks operating
articles.summary: Romania has taken the second unit of the Cernavoda nuclear power plant offline because of the record-low water level in the River Danube. Meanwhile, the Hungarian government has announced measures to enable the Paks plant to continue operating.

articles.title: Hungary plans new climate law, as Paks ramps up
articles.summary: Prime Minister Péter Magyar says that emergency works to secure the necessary water supply for Hungary’s Paks nuclear power plant have progressed faster than planned.

articles.title: First fuel loaded into Tianwan unit 7
articles.summary: The initial loading of fuel assemblies into the core of unit 7 of the Tianwan nuclear power plant has begun. It is the first of two Russian-designed VVER-1200 reactors under construction at the site in China's Jiangsu province.

articles.title: Construction of Bailong 2 conventional island begins
articles.summary: The first concrete pour has been completed for the basemat of the conventional island of unit 2 at the Bailong nuclear power plant in the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region of southern China, State Power Investment Corporation announced.

articles.title: CNNC to procure contract for high-temperature reactor
articles.summary: China National Nuclear Corporation plans to soon procure a high-temperature reactor engineering contracting project for the first phase of the Xuwei nuclear power project in China's Jiangsu province.

articles.title: TerraPower expands cooperation with Korean partners
articles.summary: US small modular reactor developer TerraPower has signed agreements with South Korea's Hyundai Engineering & Construction and SK Innovation to develop and commercialise its Natrium reactor technology across the USA, Korea and select international markets.

articles.title: Hot tests completed at third Haiyang unit
articles.summary: Tests that simulate the temperatures and pressures which the reactor systems will be subjected to during normal operation have been completed at unit 3 of the Haiyang nuclear power plant in China's Shandong province, State Power Investment Corporation has announced.

articles.title: Kaleidos microreactor begins journey to Idaho
articles.summary: Radiant's 1 MWe microreactor - which is designed to be transportable - is making the journey from California to the DOME test bed at Idaho National Laboratory on the back of a truck.

articles.title: Passive safety module installed at Zhangzhou 4
articles.summary: The third and final module of the passive reactor cavity water injection tank has been installed in the reactor building of unit 4 of the Zhangzhou nuclear power plant in China's Fujian province, China National Nuclear Corporation announced.

articles.title: Second US port to explore nuclear maritime technologies
articles.summary: The Port of Corpus Christi in Texas has signed an agreement with the US Department of Transportation's Maritime Administration to explore the use of small modular reactors, microgrids, and advanced vessel propulsion systems. The port is also to collaborate with Core Power for a site-specific maritime nuclear readiness study.

articles.title: Doosan Enerbility contracted for Natrium components
articles.summary: Doosan Enerbility of South Korea has signed a contract for the supply of key equipment for TerraPower's first Natrium sodium-cooled fast reactor power plant, in Kemmerer, Wyoming, USA.

articles.title: Blue Ghost to carry nuclear power source to the Moon
articles.summary: Firefly Aerospace and Zeno Power Systems have announced a commercial payload agreement that will see a radioisotope heating unit developed to withstand the frigid conditions of the lunar night taken on one of Firefly Aerospace's Blue Ghost missions to the moon, potentially as soon as 2028.

articles.title: Reactors installed on nuclear-powered icebreaker Leningrad
articles.summary: The two RITM-200 nuclear reactors have been installed on the nuclear-powered icebreaker Leningrad, which is under construction at the Baltic Shipyard.

articles.title: Xudabao control room simulator commissioned
articles.summary: The full-scope simulator for units 1 and 2 of the Xudabao nuclear power plant in China's Liaoning province has entered operation and will be used for training operators of the two CAP1000 reactors.

articles.title: Myanmar SMR site work 'could start in 2027'
articles.summary: Russia's state nuclear corporation Rosatom expects to sign a contract for initial engineering surveys in Myanmar by the end of the year, with work on site beginning in 2027.

articles.title: Criticality testing milestone for Westinghouse's eVinci reactor
articles.summary: Zero-power criticality testing for the eVinci microreactor has been successfully completed, Westinghouse Electric Company has announced.

articles.title: Core Power teams up with US Administration on maritime nuclear
articles.summary: Core Power said it is targeting first construction "from 2028" under a newly announced federal-private cooperation framework to accelerate the commercial, industrial and regulatory pathway for a future fleet of US-flagged nuclear-powered merchant ships.

articles.title: Blykalla submits second SMR plant application
articles.summary: Sweden's Blykalla has submitted a proposal to the Swedish government for a nuclear power plant at Untra in the Tierp municipality which would feature up to eight lead-cooled small modular reactors with a total capacity of up to 440 MWe.

articles.title: Australian reactor marks 20 years of operations
articles.summary: Australia's nuclear science and technology organisation ANSTO is marking 20 years of operations for its multi-purpose nuclear reactor at Lucas Heights in southern Sydney.

articles.title: Government approves extended operation of Almaraz plant
articles.summary: The Spanish government has granted the renewal of the operating licence for the two-unit Almaraz nuclear power plant until June 2030. Under the country's nuclear phase-out policy, unit 1 was scheduled to shut down in October 2027, with unit 2 following one year later.
